name: In-Country Scholarships for Postgraduate Studies for Palestinians in the Palestinian Territories (West Bank)
summary: The 'In-Country Scholarships for Postgraduate Studies for Palestinians in the Palestinian Territories (West Bank) ' offer Palestinian graduates the opportunity to gain a Master's degree at selected Palestinian universities in the West Bank
